ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, point R is above the circle, point S is below the circle, and point T is at the lower right of the circle. Segment RS connects R and S, and passes through the center point marked inside the circle, so RS is a diameter. Segment ST is a chord from S to T, and near arc ST there is 48° marked, indicating that the measure of minor arc ST is 48°. Reasoning: Because RS is a diameter, the measure of the right semicircular arc from R to S is 180°. The right semicircular arc is composed of arc RT and arc ST, therefore arc RT = 180° - 48° = 132°. Angle S, namely ∠RST, is an inscribed angle, and what it intercepts is arc RT. According to the inscribed angle theorem, an inscribed angle equals half the measure of the intercepted arc, so m∠S = 132° / 2 = 66°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: R, S, and T lie on the circle; segment RS passes through the marked center, so RS is a diameter; chord ST is drawn, and the minor arc from S to T is labeled 48°. The text asks for m∠S, meaning the angle at S formed by SR and ST. Since RS is a diameter, the arc from R to S on the right side is 180°. Subtract the labeled minor arc ST: arc RT = 180° - 48° = 132°. By the inscribed angle theorem, ∠RST intercepts arc RT, so m∠S = 132°/2 = 66°.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：因为 RS 是直径，所以从 R 到 S 的右半圆弧度数是 180°。右半圆弧由弧 RT 和弧 ST 组成，因此弧 RT = 180° - 48° = 132°。角 S 即 ∠RST，是圆周角，它截获的是弧 RT。根据圆周角定理，圆周角等于所截弧度数的一半，所以 m∠S = 132° / 2 = 66°。
